summary:
[  edit  ]
The Audio VST  CHOP  loads VST3 Plugin files that generate (instruments) or process (filter) audio. See the  VST  overview.
The plugin's parameters can be exposed and driven bi-directionally via a corresponding TouchDesigner parameter or the plugin's GUI control.  In order to get the full benefit of the bidirectional nature of the plugin parameters it is recommended to use  Binding  or a  Bind CHOP  when driving the parameter in TouchDesigner, rather than an expression or  CHOP  reference.
Python calls let you  send MIDI messages  to the plugin. And if the plugin generates MIDI, you can get and process the messages in the  docked  callbacks  DAT .
Depending on the plugin, the Audio VST  CHOP  takes up to 4 multi-channel inputs.
See the discussion on which VST plugins work well with TouchDesigner -  VST Plugin Testing . Also for a selection of free VSTs along with a useful set of affordable upgraded versions go here:  https://hy-plugins.com .
2 Free HY-Plugins are included with TouchDesigner and can be found using the Help > Browse Samples menu. This will open a file browser to the TouchDesigner application Samples folder which contains a VST3 folder holding one synthesizer and filter plugin for both Windows and MacOS. The Windows VST3 plugin files can be distinguished by their included "64 Bit" string.
Installed VST plugins are found in  C:Program Files/Common Files/VST  on Windows, and be  /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3  on macOS.
Tip : You can get detailed info about the VST plugin by attaching an  Info DAT  to the  CHOP .

parameters.label: File
parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The path to the VST3 plugin. Default install location for VST3 plugins is  C:/Program Files/Common Files/VST3  on Windows and  /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3  on macOS.

parameters.label: Reload
parameters.name: reloadpulse
parameters.description: Reloads the VST3 plugin. Pulsing will clear all learned parameters and reset the GUI, as well as any stashed plugin data. Basically, it resets the plugin to a default state.

parameters.label: Load Plugin State on Start
parameters.name: loadpluginstate
parameters.description: The plugin state (including preset value and other UI elements) is saved into the toe file and is restored on TouchDesigner start, if enabled. The toggle exists to provide a work-around to plugins that do not behave well (eg. crash) when their plugin state is set; the toggle should be disabled in those cases.

parameters.label: Sample Rate
parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Sets the sample rate of the VST3 plugin.

parameters.label: Plugin GUI Always on Top
parameters.name: alwaysontop
parameters.description: When enabled, the plugin window will always be on top of other windows.

parameters.label: Display Plugin GUI
parameters.name: displaygui
parameters.description: When pulsed, will open the plugin GUI in a separate window. Changing a parameter in the plugin GUI while the learn toggle is enabled will create the parameter on the Audio VST  CHOP  side.

parameters.label: Learn Parameters
parameters.name: learnparms
parameters.description: When enabled, parameters that are interacted with in the VST Plugin window will be created as parameters on the Plugin page, ie. they will be learned.

parameters.label: Regular Parameters
parameters.name: regularparms
parameters.description: When enabled, every Plugin parameter will be created on the Plugin page.

parameters.label: Read-Only Parameters
parameters.name: readonlyparms
parameters.description: When enabled, all read-only Plugin parameters will be created on the Plugin page. If Regular Parameters is also toggled on then this toggle will have no effect.

parameters.label: Clear Learned Parameters
parameters.name: clearlearnedparms
parameters.description: When pulsed, all learned parameters will be cleared. If neither Regular or Read-only parameters are toggled on then the parameters will be destroyed.

parameters.label: Callbacks  DAT
parameters.name: callbacks
parameters.description: Reference  to the  DAT  containing Audio VST  CHOP  supported callbacks.

parameters.label: Custom Bus  Layout
parameters.name: custombuslayout
parameters.description: Enables custom bus layout. If disabled the bus layout will be the plugin's default.

parameters.label: Output Bus  Layout
parameters.name: outputbuslayout
parameters.description: Select the output bus layout (ie. number of channels) of the output bus. This will directly affect how many channels the Audio VST  CHOP  has.

parameters.label: Main Input Bus  Layout
parameters.name: maininputlayout
parameters.description: Select the main input bus layout (ie. number of channels). The main input bus is always the  CHOP 's first input, and this selection determines how many channels it accepts from it.

parameters.label: Aux Input
parameters.name: aux
parameters.description: This sequence describes the aux inputs to the VST plugin

parameters.label: Enable
parameters.name: aux0enable
parameters.description: Enable the auxiliary bus.

parameters.label: Bus  Layout
parameters.name: aux0layout
parameters.description: Select the auxiliary bus layout (ie. number of channels) for the auxiliary input. An auxiliary input is every input after the main input. Not every plugin will support auxiliary buses, and the parameter will be disabled if not supported. If no more sequential auxiliary buses can be added (ie. the +/- disappears in the parameter sequence) then that means the auxiliary bus maximum has been reached.

parameters.label: Custom Playhead
parameters.name: customplayhead
parameters.description: Enable the custom playhead. When disabled, the plugin will always sequentially step forward in time. Not all plugins support a custom playhead.

parameters.label: Timecode  Object / CHOP / DAT
parameters.name: timecodeop
parameters.description: Specifies the playhead time of the plugin. A reference to either a  CHOP  with channels 'hour', 'second', 'minute', 'frame', a  DAT  with a timecode string in its first cell, or a  Timecode Class  object.

parameters.label: Tempo (bpm)
parameters.name: tempo
parameters.description: The tempo of the playhead. Not all plugins support changing of the tempo via the playhead.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: ⊞  - The time signature of the playhead. Not all plugins support changing of the time signature via the playhead.

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope
parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page. See  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match
parameters.name: srselect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

parameters.label: Resample At First Input's Rate
parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Use rate of first input to resample others.

parameters.label: Resample At Maximum Rate
parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Resample to the highest sample rate.

parameters.label: Resample At Minimum Rate
parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Resample to the lowest sample rate.

parameters.label: Error If Rates Differ
parameters.name: err
parameters.description: Doesn't accept conflicting sample rates.

parameters.label: Export  Method
parameters.name: exportmethod
parameters.description: ⊞  - This will determine how to connect the  CHOP  channel to the parameter. Refer to the  Export  article for more information.

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Index
parameters.name: datindex
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the index of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Name
parameters.name: datname
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the name of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: Channel Name is  Path : Parameter
parameters.name: autoname
parameters.description: The channel is the full destination of where to export to, such has  geo1/transform1:tx .

parameters.label: Export   Root
parameters.name: autoexportroot
parameters.description: This path points to the root node where all of the paths that exporting by  Channel Name is  Path : Parameter   are relative to.

parameters.label: Export  Table
parameters.name: exporttable
parameters.description: The  DAT  used to hold the export information when using the  DAT  Table  Export  Methods (See above).

parameters.label: Rename from
parameters.name: commonrenamefrom
parameters.description: The channel pattern to rename. See  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Rename to
parameters.name: commonrenameto
parameters.description: The replacement pattern for the names. The default parameters do not rename the channels. See  Pattern Replacement .

parameters.label: Channel Names:  c[1
parameters.description: 10:2] ambient

parameters.label: Rename To:  b[1
parameters.description: 5] amb    This example fetches channels  c1 c3 c5 c7 c9  and  ambient .

parameters.label: start
parameters.description: Start of the  CHOP  interval in samples.

parameters.label: length
parameters.description: Number of samples in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: sample_rate
parameters.description: The samplerate of the channels in frames per second.

parameters.label: num_channels
parameters.description: Number of channels in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: time_slice
parameters.description: 1 if  CHOP  is  Time Slice  enabled, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: export_sernum
parameters.description: A count of how often the export connections have been updated.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: An  Operator Family  that manipulates text strings: multi
parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: samples
parameters.description: per-second of a  CHOP . Each CHOP in your network has a sample rate. In contrast, the overall timeline has a  Frame Rate , which is the number of frames to  cook  and display per second, generally your monitor display frequency, default 60.

parameters.label: The sub
parameters.description: Family  of  Component  types that are used to define and render 3D scenes. A  Geometry Component  is an Object that contains the 3D shapes to render. A  Camera COMP  and  Light COMP  are other Object types. Separately, "Objects" also refers to Python objects.

parameters.label: TouchDesigner is a hierarchy of components. "root" is the top
parameters.description: most network in the hierarchy. The  Network Path  or Path for root is simply  / . A typical path is  /project1/moviein1 .
